artboards.title: Block component — one row per thing

annotations.text:
Read the top row first: how one notification travels from the feature that raised it to the screens below.

The bottom row is the same notification as the user meets it — the toast that interrupts, then the Center that remembers.

Both screens are drawn from the real components: 64px rail, 24px card radius, the app's own night-bridge cover art, and the accent/success/warning tokens already in the theme.

Nothing here introduces a new colour.
